correctness.rationale: For a nonconstant circular binary 010-avoider every one-run has length >=2 and each zero-run length >=1. The cyclic list of t paired one-runs and zero-runs is unique up to slot rotation; v long zero gaps, A excess zeros, and B excess ones yield exactly profile (A,v,0,t,v,t-v,t,B) with n=3t+v+A+B and v=0=>A=0. Burnside fixed points under rotations of order d require d dividing t,v,A,B and give the claimed totient/binomial formula. Exhaustive disjoint casework of v=0, v=t, v=1, v=t-1 and interior gives precisely the singleton iff criterion, with constants separate. Geometric sums of parameter counts yield the displayed rational C_n and U_n generating functions; primitive order-3 and order-4 poles survive, giving exact eventual least period 12, C~n³/72 and U~4n/3. Independent full necklace/fiber enumeration through n=11 matches the formula, not an infinite proof.
